title: Reading a product result bit
statement: Let $x$ be a finite bit string and let $v$ assign natural numbers to $13$ registers, with every register value at most $4(|x|+1)$ and register $1$ equal to $|x|$. Starting in the result-test state with register values $v$ and no answer recorded, the multiplication machine can reach the parity state labelled by the bit of $x$ at position $v(12)$, while satisfying its prescribed validity and register-bound conditions at every intermediate step.
hypotheses_covered: Every register value is at most $4(|x|+1)$
